targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at::timestamp) AS time, count(*) AS questions FROM interactions WHERE source = 'live' AND event = 'answer' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at::timestamp) AS time, count(*) AS events FROM interactions WHERE feedback IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM interactions WHERE source = 'live' AND event = 'answer'
SELECT coalesce(retrieval_mode, 'unknown') AS mode, count(*) AS value FROM interactions WHERE source = 'live' GROUP BY 1
SELECT created_at, question, retrieval_mode FROM interactions WHERE source = 'live' AND event = 'answer' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM interactions WHERE feedback = 'positive'
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM interactions WHERE feedback = 'negative'
SELECT source, count(*) AS interactions FROM interactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM interactions WHERE source = 'live' AND event = 'answer' AND citation_grounded = false
SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS value FROM interactions WHERE source = 'live' AND event = 'answer'
SELECT coalesce(sum(estimated_cost), 0) AS value FROM interactions WHERE source = 'live'
SELECT abstention_type, error_type, count(*) FROM interactions WHERE source = 'live' GROUP BY 1, 2

panels.title: Measurement freshness by source and station

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, station_name, max(observed_at) AS newest_observation, round(extract(epoch FROM (now() - max(observed_at)))::numeric, 0) AS age_seconds, count(*) AS observations FROM measurements GROUP BY source, station_name ORDER BY age_seconds DESC

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at::timestamp) AS time, route, sum(coalesce(token_usage, 0)) AS tokens, sum(coalesce(estimated_cost, 0)) AS cost FROM interactions WHERE source = 'live' AND event = 'answer' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT route, count(*) AS answers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE source_count >= 2) AS multi_source_answers FROM interactions WHERE source = 'live' AND event = 'answer' GROUP BY route ORDER BY answers DESC

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at::timestamp) AS time, avg(coalesce(history_messages, 0)) AS avg_history_messages, count(*) FILTER (WHERE conversation_turn > 1) AS follow_ups FROM interactions WHERE source = 'live' AND event = 'answer' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
